name: 2152: Pizza Pocket
source:
2152: Pizza Pocket is a short visual novel about finding a pizza pocket. That's it. That's the game.

You play as Jioni, a somewhat irresponsible teenager with an affinity for bad luck, especially when dealing with the different personalities around her in City Two. Jioni must learn to disregard her intrusive thoughts to reach her goal. (That goal is a pizza pocket, of course.) Navigate through this post-apocalyptic city to acquire this processed pizza substitute.

[from [url=https://madiroseart.itch.io/2152-pizza-pocket]Itch.io[/url]]
